Flow.description: JF 6/21/24: Updated for This License Period + Renewal

formulas.name: Remarks
formulas.expression: TRIM( IF( NOT( ISBLANK({!Privilege}) ) , "RENEWED WITH " + {!Privilege} , IF( {!RenewingPermittoPractice} = 'No' , "RENEWED WITHOUT PERMIT TO PRACTICE" , "") + "This License Period + Renewal" ) + " " + IF( AND(TEXT({!Get_License.LicenseType__r.AuditType__c}) = "Pre-Audit", {!Get_License.FlaggedforAudit__c} = True) , "Selected for Audit" ,"") )

formulas.name: RenewalRemark
formulas.expression: TRIM( IF( NOT( ISBLANK({!Privilege}) ) , "RENEWED WITH " + {!Privilege} , IF( {!RenewingPermittoPractice} = 'No' , "RENEWED WITHOUT PERMIT TO PRACTICE" , "")) + " " + IF( NOT( ISBLANK({!OnlineApplicationTypeFlow})) ,"ELECTRONIC RENEWAL" ,"") + " " + IF( AND(TEXT({!Get_License.LicenseType__r.AuditType__c}) = "Pre-Audit", {!Get_License.FlaggedforAudit__c} = True) , "Selected for Audit" ,"") )

formulas.name: TransactionType
formulas.expression: CASE({!Get_Application.Type__c} , "RNEW - Renewal" , "RNEW - RENEWED" , "RSTR - Restore - No A/I Status" , "RSTR - RESTORED (LICENSE WAS DELINQUENT/FORFEITED)" , "LICF - New License after Forfeiture" , "LICF - NEW LICENSE AFTER FORFEITURE" , "REAC - Reactivation" , "REAC - REACTIVATED" , "ADDP - Additional Special Privilege" , "ADDP - ADD SPECIAL PRIVILEGE" , "" )

formulas.name: TransactionTypeBouncedCheck
formulas.expression:
CASE( {!Get_Application.Type__c},
"RNEW - Renewal", "BCRN - BOUNCED CHECK - RENEWAL",
"RSTR - Restore - No A/I Status", "BCRS - BOUNCED CHECK - RESTORATION",
"")

formulas.name: TransactionTypeBouncedCheckPaidLICNLICF
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Get_Application.Type__c}, "LICN - New License", "BPNL - BOUNCED CHECK REPAYMENT, NEW LICENSE", "LICF - New License after Forfeiture", "BPLF - BOUNCED CHECK REPAYMENT, LICF", "")

formulas.name: TransactionTypeBouncedCheckPaidRNEWRSTR
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Get_Application.Type__c}, "RNEW - Renewal", "BPRN - BOUNCED CHECK RENEWALS, REPAYMENT RENEWALS", "RSTR - Restore - No A/I Status", "BPRS - BOUNCED CHECK RENEWALS, REPAYMENT RESTORATION", "")
